Theorem
[$L^1$ vanishing] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0183 1. ch12:12.24\group Heat Equation Uniqueness

Let $(M,g)$ be complete, noncompact, and have a negative quadratic Ricci lower bound. If $u\geq 0$ is a heat subsolution, $u(\cdot ,t)\in L^1(M)$ for every $t>0$, and $\lim _{t\downarrow 0}\int _Mu(x,t)\, d\mu =0$, then $u=0$ on $M\times (0,\infty )$.
